15.text: Polio is caused by poliovirus.
Polio is a viral disease.
Humans are the host of polio.
Polio is transmitted by the fecal–oral route.
Contaminated food and water transmit polio.
Polio affects the spinal cord and central nervous system.
Polio can cause paralysis.
COVID-19 is caused by SARS-CoV-2.
COVID-19 is a viral disease.
Humans are the host of COVID-19.
COVID-19 is transmitted through respiratory and contact routes.
COVID-19 affects the respiratory system.
COVID-19 can cause multi-organ complications.
Rabies is caused by rabies lyssavirus.
Rabies is a viral zoonotic disease.
Dogs, cats, bats, foxes and other animals can host rabies.
Rabies is transmitted through bites or scratches.
Rabies is transmitted through saliva.
Rabies affects the nervous system.
Rabies can cause hydrophobia.
Hepatitis-B is caused by HBV.
Hepatitis-B is a viral disease.
Humans are the host of Hepatitis-B.
Hepatitis-B is transmitted through blood and body fluids.
Hepatitis-B is transmitted sexually.
Hepatitis-B can pass from mother to child.
Hepatitis-B affects the liver.
Mumps is caused by mumps virus.
Mumps is a viral disease.
Humans are the host of mumps.
Mumps is transmitted through saliva and nasal secretions.
Mumps is transmitted by contact.
Mumps affects the salivary or parotid glands.
Dengue is caused by dengue virus.
Dengue is a viral disease.
Aedes mosquitoes transmit dengue.
Dengue is transmitted by mosquito bite.
Dengue can reduce platelet counts.
Chikungunya is caused by CHIKV.
Chikungunya is a viral disease.
Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus transmit chikungunya.
Chikungunya is transmitted by mosquito bite.
Chikungunya causes severe joint pain.
Zika is caused by Zika virus.
Zika is a viral disease.
Aedes mosquitoes transmit Zika.
Zika can be transmitted by mosquitoes.
Zika can be transmitted through blood.
Zika can be transmitted sexually.
Zika can cause fever.
Zika can cause rash.
Zika can cause joint pain.
Yellow fever is caused by yellow fever virus.
Yellow fever is a viral disease.
Aedes aegypti transmits yellow fever.
Yellow fever is transmitted by mosquito bite.
Yellow fever causes fever.
Yellow fever can cause haemorrhagic disease.
AIDS is caused by HIV.
AIDS is a viral retrovirus disease.
Humans are the host of AIDS.
AIDS is transmitted through blood.
AIDS is transmitted sexually.
AIDS can pass from mother to child.
AIDS affects the immune system.
Ebola is caused by Ebola virus.
Ebola is a viral zoonotic disease.
Animals and non-human primates can host Ebola.
Ebola can pass from animals to humans.
Ebola can be transmitted between humans.
Ebola causes haemorrhagic disease.
Nipah is caused by Nipah virus.
Nipah is a viral zoonotic disease.
Animals can host Nipah.
Pigs are discussed as a source of Nipah.
Nipah can be transmitted between animals and humans.
Nipah causes severe viral disease.
Measles is caused by measles virus.
Measles is a viral disease.
Humans are the host of measles.
Measles is transmitted through respiratory routes.
Measles is highly contagious.
Japanese encephalitis is caused by JEV.
Japanese encephalitis is a viral disease.
Culex mosquitoes transmit Japanese encephalitis.
Pigs and wild birds are reservoirs of Japanese encephalitis.
Japanese encephalitis is transmitted by mosquito bite.
Japanese encephalitis affects the brain.
Ranikhet or Newcastle disease is caused by a virus.
Ranikhet or Newcastle disease is a viral disease.
Chickens are the host of Ranikhet or Newcastle disease.
Ranikhet or Newcastle disease is infectious.
Ranikhet or Newcastle disease affects poultry.
Rinderpest is caused by Morbillivirus.
Rinderpest is a viral disease.
Cattle and buffalo are hosts of rinderpest.
Rinderpest is contagious.
Rinderpest affects livestock.
Bird flu is caused by H5N1.
Bird flu is a viral disease.
Birds and poultry can host bird flu.
Bird flu can pass from birds to humans.
Human transmission of bird flu is mentioned.
Bird flu affects the respiratory system.
Swine flu is caused by H1N1.
Swine flu is a viral disease.
Pigs are hosts of swine flu.
Swine flu affects the respiratory system.
Swine flu is influenza.
Foot-and-mouth disease is caused by Aphthovirus.
Foot-and-mouth disease is a viral disease.
Cattle, goats, pigs and sheep can host foot-and-mouth disease.
Foot-and-mouth disease is infectious.
Foot-and-mouth disease affects cloven-hoofed animals.
Cholera is caused by Vibrio cholerae.
Cholera is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of cholera.
Cholera is transmitted through contaminated food and water.
Cholera affects the small intestine.
Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis or Pasteurella pestis.
Plague is a bacterial disease.
Plague involves a rat-flea cycle.
Fleas act as vectors of plague.
Plague affects the lymph nodes.
Plague can cause buboes.
Leprosy is caused by Mycobacterium leprae or M. lepromatosis.
Leprosy is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of leprosy.
Leprosy is infectious.
Leprosy affects the skin.
Leprosy affects peripheral nerves.
Pneumonia is mainly caused by bacteria.
Streptococcus pneumoniae is a main cause of pneumonia.
Viral and fungal causes of pneumonia are also noted.
Humans are the host of pneumonia.
Pneumonia is infectious.
Pneumonia affects the lungs.
Typhoid is caused by Salmonella typhi.
Typhoid is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of typhoid.
Typhoid is transmitted through contaminated food and water.
Typhoid affects the intestinal tract.
Diphtheria is caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae.
Diphtheria is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of diphtheria.
Diphtheria is transmitted through respiratory routes.
Diphtheria affects the throat and nose.
Gonorrhoea is caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae.
Gonorrhoea is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of gonorrhoea.
Gonorrhoea is transmitted sexually.
Gonorrhoea affects the reproductive organs.
Syphilis is caused by Treponema palladium.
Syphilis is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of syphilis.
Syphilis is transmitted sexually.
Syphilis affects the genitals, rectum and mouth.
Pertussis is caused by Bordetella pertussis.
Pertussis is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of pertussis.
Pertussis is transmitted through respiratory routes.
Pertussis causes whooping cough.
Tetanus is caused by Clostridium tetani.
Tetanus is a bacterial disease.
Soil and other sources are associated with tetanus.
Tetanus is transmitted through contaminated wounds.
Tetanus causes muscle spasms.
Tetanus can cause jaw spasms.
Tuberculosis is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
Tuberculosis is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of tuberculosis.
Tuberculosis is transmitted through respiratory routes.
Tuberculosis affects the lungs.
Rheumatic fever is caused by Streptococcus pyogenes.
Rheumatic fever is a bacterial disease.
Humans are the host of rheumatic fever.
Rheumatic fever follows an infection.
Rheumatic fever affects the heart.
Rheumatic fever affects the brain.
Rheumatic fever affects the joints.
Rheumatic fever affects the skin.
Botulism is caused by Clostridium botulinum toxin.
Botulism is a bacterial intoxication.
Food, wounds and infants are associated with botulism.
Botulism is transmitted through food and wounds.
Botulism affects the nerves.
Botulism can cause paralysis.
Malaria is caused by Plasmodium.
Malaria is a protozoan disease.
Female Anopheles mosquitoes transmit malaria.
Malaria can also be transmitted through blood transfusion and needles.
Malaria affects the liver.
Malaria affects red blood cells.
Malaria can cause an enlarged spleen.
Kala-azar is caused by Leishmania.
Kala-azar is a protozoan disease.
Sandflies transmit kala-azar.
Dogs are reservoirs of kala-azar.
Kala-azar can be transmitted through blood and needles.
Kala-azar affects the liver.
Kala-azar affects the spleen.
Kala-azar affects the bone marrow.
Sleeping sickness is caused by Trypanosoma brucei.
Sleeping sickness is a protozoan disease.
Tsetse flies transmit sleeping sickness.
Sleeping sickness is transmitted by bite.
Sleeping sickness affects the brain and central nervous system in later stages.
Amoebiasis is caused by Entamoeba histolytica.
Amoebiasis is a protozoan disease.
Humans are the host of amoebiasis.
Amoebiasis is transmitted through contaminated food and water.
Amoebiasis affects the intestine.
Schistosomiasis is caused by Schistosoma.
Schistosomiasis is caused by a parasitic flatworm.
Snails are intermediate hosts of schistosomiasis.
Schistosomiasis is transmitted through unsafe water.
Schistosomiasis affects the urinary tract.
Schistosomiasis affects the intestine.
Fascioliasis is caused by Fasciola hepatica or Fasciola gigantica.
Fascioliasis is caused by a parasitic worm.
Ruminants are the main hosts of fascioliasis.
Fascioliasis is transmitted through raw water plants.
Fascioliasis affects the liver.
Fascioliasis affects the bile ducts.
Neurocysticercosis is caused by Taenia solium eggs.
Neurocysticercosis is a parasitic disease.
Humans are the host of neurocysticercosis.
Neurocysticercosis is transmitted through contaminated food and water.
Neurocysticercosis affects the brain and central nervous system.
Filariasis is caused by Wuchereria bancrofti.
Filariasis is a nematode disease.
Culex mosquitoes transmit filariasis.
Filariasis is transmitted by mosquito bite.
Filariasis affects the lymph glands.
Filariasis can cause elephantiasis.
Ascariasis is caused by Ascaris lumbricoides.
Ascariasis is a nematode disease.
Humans are the host of ascariasis.
Ascariasis is transmitted by ingestion of eggs.
Ascariasis affects the small intestine.
Athlete's foot is caused by Trichophyton, Epidermophyton and Microsporum.
Athlete's foot is a fungal disease.
Humans are the host of athlete's foot.
Athlete's foot is transmitted through contaminated floors, towels and clothes.
Athlete's foot affects the skin of the foot.
Mucormycosis is caused by Mucormycetes.
Mucormycosis is a fungal disease.
The environment is associated with mucormycosis.
The source or vector of mucormycosis is not specified.
Mucormycosis affects the nose, sinuses, eyes and brain.
Aspergillosis is caused by Aspergillus.
Aspergillosis is a fungal disease.
Humans, birds and animals are associated with aspergillosis.
Aspergillosis can be respiratory or systemic.
Ergotism is caused by Claviceps purpurea toxin.
Ergotism is a fungal intoxication.
Rye and cereals are associated with ergotism.
Ergotism is transmitted through ingestion.
Ergotism affects the nervous, vascular and endocrine systems.
Cancer is caused by abnormal cell growth and oncogene mutations.
Cancer is non-contagious.
Cancer can affect any organ.
Cancer can cause metastasis.
Leukaemia is caused by abnormal white blood cell production.
Leukaemia is non-contagious.
Leukaemia affects the bone marrow and blood.
Goitre is caused by iodine deficiency.
Goitre is a deficiency disease.
Goitre affects the thyroid.
Beriberi is caused by vitamin B1 deficiency.
Beriberi is a deficiency disease.
Beriberi affects the heart and nervous system.
Kwashiorkor is caused by protein deficiency.
Kwashiorkor is a deficiency disease.
Kwashiorkor affects growth.
Kwashiorkor affects the liver.
Marasmus is caused by energy and protein deficiency.
Marasmus is a deficiency disease.
Marasmus causes severe wasting.
Night blindness is caused by vitamin A deficiency.
Night blindness is a deficiency disease.
Night blindness affects the eye.
Rickets is caused by vitamin D deficiency.
Rickets is a deficiency disease.
Rickets affects the bones.
Scurvy is caused by vitamin C deficiency.
Scurvy is a deficiency disease.
Scurvy affects connective tissue and gums.
Pellagra is caused by niacin or vitamin B3 deficiency.
Pellagra is a deficiency disease.
Pellagra affects the skin, gastrointestinal system and nervous system.
